prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished logo concept presentation for ToolDawn, an international online AI tools directory and productivity platform. Brand traits: useful, clear, approachable, expertly made. This is a real identity exploration, not a stock symbol.
Canvas: square 1024x1024. Upper 75 percent pure white. Large isolated symbol centered near x512 y300 (approximately 260px size), with exact brand wordmark "ToolDawn" centered below at y540, generous whitespace. Lower 25 percent solid charcoal #101719: a smaller horizontal lockup of the SAME symbol and exact "ToolDawn" wordmark in white/mint, aligned centrally. In concept 10 prioritize the custom wordmark and use its companion D as the upper isolated symbol. Only text is "ToolDawn", spelled exactly with capital T and D. Do not add numbers, captions, slogans, dimensions or watermarks; these will be added separately outside the image.
Style: refined professional brand identity, vector-like sharp flat artwork, optical balance, clean medium-weight custom sans wordmark, readable at small sizes, suitable favicon and admin sidebar. No photography, no mockup objects, no shadows, no gradients, no texture, no embossing, no outlines that are too thin, no generic gear, no wrench clipart. Light and dark lockups must use identical geometry. Do not copy existing brands.
Specific design direction: A strong architectural D-shaped portal with a small rising sun cut into its inner counter at the horizon. One unified bold silhouette, not an illustration. Deep teal and a restrained warm sunrise accent. Calm, welcoming, iconic.
